meta.defaultTitle: Track – AI-first tag manager and server-side event router
meta.defaultDescription: One snippet, an AI setup assistant and a consent-aware server-side event router. First-party events, deduplicated conversions and transparent delivery to every ad and analytics platform.

footer.tagline: AI-first tag manager, consent-aware server-side event router and first-party event layer.
footer.region: EU data region by default. Processor under Art. 28 GDPR.
footer.legalNote: Legal pages are provided as information, not legal advice.

home.title: One snippet. Every platform. Consent built in.
home.subtitle: Paste one asynchronous script, tell the assistant what your site does and get verified first-party events routed server-side to Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and 15 more destinations, deduplicated and consent-gated.
home.domainHelp: We create your site, a public six-character tracking ID and guide you through the rest in chat.
home.problemTitle: Tag managers were built for experts. Yours should not require one.
home.problemText: Client-side pixels lose events, server-side setups need engineers, and consent is usually a banner rather than a technical rule. Track turns all of it into one guided setup with an event router that enforces privacy before anything is stored or sent.

items.title: Install one snippet
items.text: Add the asynchronous tracker with your six-character site ID. No layout shift, no impact on checkout, fail-safe if anything is wrong.

items.title: Answer a few questions
items.text: The assistant detects your platform, proposes a measurement plan and connects destinations with validated inputs and secure credential cards.

items.title: Test, review, publish
items.text: Every change is a signed configuration version with a readable diff. Publish only after you confirm. Roll back with one click.

items.title: Watch events flow
items.text: Live event debugger, delivery status per destination, deduplication and a tracking health score that tells you what to fix next.

features.title: Built as a data, consent and routing layer, not another script container

items.title: First-party event layer
items.text: Canonical events with lineage from browser to destination. Unknown stays unknown; nothing is invented.

items.title: Consent as a policy engine
items.text: Strict EU defaults, Consent Mode v2, TCF, GPP, GPC and the common CMPs. Server-side never bypasses a missing consent.

items.title: Server-side router
items.text: Durable queue, per-destination isolation, retries with backoff, dead-letter replay and idempotent conversions.

items.title: AI setup assistant
items.text: Strictly typed tools, drafts, diffs and explicit approval. The model never touches the event pipeline.

items.title: Commerce-grade dedup
items.text: Same event ID in browser and server, order IDs as source of truth, no double conversions on replay.

items.title: Transparent diagnostics
items.text: Payload previews with redacted secrets, drop reasons, delivery errors and data-quality inbox.

integrations.title: Destinations included in the first release
integrations.text: Browser tag plus server-side API for every platform that offers one, with shared event IDs for deduplication.

security.title: Privacy is enforced technically
items: Row-level security isolates every tenant in the database
Envelope-encrypted credentials; secrets never enter chat, logs or the model
Signed, immutable config bundles verified in the browser
No fingerprinting, no consent bypass, no synthetic conversions

finalCta.title: Ready for verified events in minutes?
finalCta.text: Create your site, paste the snippet and let the assistant do the rest.
